guarantees.claim: When SecMasking is disabled (compile-time), prd_q is directly assigned to prd_i, bypassing any mask insertion.

assumptions.claim: SecMasking is a compile-time constant set to 0 only when the security policy mandates no masking.
assumptions.cond: always when this generate block is active
assumptions.risk: If misconfigured, secret key bytes would pass through without masking, leaking side-channel information.

uncertain_points.claim: The RTL comment mentions tie-off of unused signals, but no explicit assignments are visible in this chunk. Unused mask inputs may be left floating.
uncertain_points.risk: Floating mask inputs could propagate X in simulation or lead to synthesis warnings, potentially hiding functional bugs.
